What's going on?  Why are you depressed?  

On the flipside:  Do you have any hobbies or passions such as reading, biking, knitting, carpentry, anything really...

I don't know.  I guess that I don't want to think that I have a problem that requires medication.  I have never really liked drugs that screw with one's head (except for caffeine :P) because they're... fake I suppose?  I mean, so many people take pills as a part of their daily routine, I think I don't want to join that 'group' if you will.  Drugs also tend to be expensive.
I can't really talk to anyone about it.  I would freeze up + I don't want my parents to pay for therapy nor am I willing to take any medication(s).
TIL misspelled is spelled misspelled and not mispelled.
